newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen rising after Dow recovery.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen rising after Dow recovery.

text.p: Danish share prices were expected to rise on Wednesday after the overnight recovery in the Dow Jones index but some dealers feared that trade would be jittery due to the uncertain bond market.
"It looks like we can expect to see rises today but it all depends on how the other bourses in Europe and the bond market behave," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 1.88 point or 1.22 percent down on Tuesday at 152.70, after recovering from earlier lows in a market hit by Wall Street declines.
